plan: For capital preservation, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name limit.
This plan prioritizes safety and reduces overall portfolio risk significantly.
It aims to minimize drawdowns and maintain a stable portfolio value.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and smaller drawdowns, but also limited upside potential.

plan: For balanced growth, trim all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to small allocations.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration limit.
Buy NOW at 4% as a strong risk/reward long setup from the scanner.
This plan reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a quality growth name.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth with a risk-first approach. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, balancing growth potential with risk management.

plan: For aggressive growth, add to all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to 6% each.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration limit.
Buy NOW at 6% as a high-conviction scanner setup.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for higher potential returns, with strict stop discipline.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by stretching into leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: For income, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to zero.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for enhanced monthly distributions.
This plan prioritizes steady income and low drawdown over growth.
It aims to create a cash-like income stream from covered-call ETFs.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on generating steady monthly distributions. It eliminates leveraged and high-beta holdings, concentrating on income-generating ETFs. While prioritizing low drawdown, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
